splitOff.why: It changes the arrival date hint's worked example on the animals arrival details page so the example is today's date and always falls inside the arrival window. The example has to be worked out from the clock alongside the window bounds in frontend:src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/port-of-entry, and the hint assertion it changes is in tests:tests/animals/e2e/pages/arrival-details.spec.ts and tests:page-objects/animals/arrival-details-page.ts, all three of which theme arrival-and-transit owns.
